senses.gloss: m. (פטש, v. preced.; cmp. כִּיתַּן a. כְּתוֹנֶת) [linen,] undergarment, breeches.
units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>חזי … דלא הוה ברגלי פ׳</he> (<he>חד מתלמידוי</he>) <cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite> (Ar. <cite ref="Q02059"><he>פשוש</he></cite>) I saw in my dream that I had no breeches on my legs.—Pl. <he>פְּטִישִׁין</he>, <cite ref="Q00529"><he>פַּטִּי׳</he></cite>, <he>פַּטְשִׁ׳</he>.
